objective_for_doctor:
Age: 22
Sex: Female
Chief Complaint: I have lower chest pain, left side of the chest pain, and upper chest pain

turns.doctor_opening: Hello, what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what's been going on?
turns.patient_opening: Hi. I’m a 22-year-old woman, and today I came in because I’ve been having lower chest pain on the left side and also upper chest pain. It’s a tedious, exhausting kind of pain, around 5 out of 10, and it can get worse with exertion—also I feel significant shortness of breath, and the pain sometimes goes to my right biceps, my thoracic spine, under my jaw, and my right shoulder. I also feel epigastric pain and left breast pain, and I’m a current smoker; I have diabetes and high cholesterol, and I have family history of early heart problems.
